ALTER TABLE catalog_classification_snapshot ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_snapshot_subject_type CHECK (subject_type IN ('ASSET', 'COLUMN', 'FILE', 'SCREEN_COMPONENT')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_snapshot_declared CHECK (declared_level IS NULL OR declared_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_snapshot_detected CHECK (detected_level IS NULL OR detected_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_snapshot_manual_floor CHECK (manual_floor IS NULL OR manual_floor IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_snapshot_effective CHECK (effective_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL'));
ALTER TABLE catalog_classification_event ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_event_previous CHECK (previous_level IS NULL OR previous_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_event_candidate CHECK (candidate_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL')), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_catalog_classification_event_resulting CHECK (resulting_level IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL', 'SECRET', 'CONFIDENTIAL'));
